name: Byoujaku na Gouhou Shounen Doukyuusei no Shasei Kaijo o Suru Koto ni Nattan da ga
original_name: 病弱な合法少年同級生の射精介助をすることになったんだが
source: Hisao is woken up in the middle of the night by Tomoya, who needs help after soiling himself.
translation: Hisao is woken up in the middle of the night by Tomoya, who needs help after soiling himself.
